1936, May
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 111 Cont.
May 6 Rufus Shaw - 39 - "nothing" - wife Catholic - has some one else now after three yrs. Dorothy Parker Mrs. Pechler - 48 - goiter.
Page 112
May 7 Alice Desmond - 56 - taken to hospital in ambulance 1933 ... hopeless case cancer. Today in perfect health ... only cured out 121158 cases cured. Deo Gr.
Students wanted at Brescia Hall. L.
Monica, Robert and J. Hickey - nun sister asks for prayers.
11 Antonia Joly - 53 - high blood pressure, heart, etc.
Mildred Gunther - 32 - Lutheran - like curviture of spine - four sisters & 2 br's Marie Kremalmer - 28 - spells. ... Carmelo Clem - 11 - .... fits Nancy Wetherly - 4 - in - cold after cold all time Nora Dalton - 60 - operation blood-cancer Charlotte Klokow & husband.
Helen O'Flynn - 29 - lost her little child and .... no
Page 113 May 20 Harold Snyder - 50 - Methodist accidently ran a wire into his eye Nov. 2, 34 - has been having trouble with it off and on every since Lately seems to
Titus Denk - 50 -
Michael Wassin - 30 - has a wife and two little daughters 3 & 6. Had cateract removed four weeks ago - unsuccessful, now Drs. - want to remove the eye. Enrolls To-night.
Titus Denk - 50 - & Daughter 22 - away from wife & mother - giving up the faith .. . Wife & mother heart broken ... now over 3 yrs ....
